rabbi-yannai-berabbi-yishmael.name: Rabbi Yannai son of Rabbi Yishmael
rabbi-yannai-berabbi-yishmael.bio: Amora of the Land of Israel, cited in the Talmud by this name.
rabbi-yannai-berabbi-yishmael.prompt: A scholar in his 50s with a dark beard touched with grey and a thoughtful, measured expression, one hand raised as if offering an alternative answer; background of limestone arches and olive trees.

abba-shaul.name: Abba Shaul
abba-shaul.bio: Tanna whose rulings and traditions are cited in the Mishnah and baraitot.
abba-shaul.prompt: A tall sage in his 60s with a full grey beard and a calm, unhurried expression, standing upright among seated students; background of the Yavne study hall with limestone arches.

rabbi-shimon-ben-elazar.name: Rabbi Shimon ben Elazar
rabbi-shimon-ben-elazar.bio: Tanna, a student of Rabbi Meir, whose teachings he often transmits.
rabbi-shimon-ben-elazar.prompt: A sage in his 50s with a dark beard streaked with grey and a warm storyteller's expression, one hand open as if recounting an incident he heard from his teacher; background of limestone arches and olive trees.
